summary: Enhance your non-profit's impact with our Data Analytics Training Course. Learn to leverage data for informed decision-making and improved outcomes.
lede: Data analysis for nonprofits helps impact, fundraising, and program teams use CRM, survey, and finance data to assess outcomes and resource use. For non-profit professionals measuring impact, managing donors, or reporting to funders, the course covers cleaning field data, defining indicators from logic models, and analyzing donor retention and program costs. Participants also practice designing impact dashboards and presenting findings in clear reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for non-profit professionals responsible for measuring impact, managing donor relationships, and reporting to institutional funders.
modules: Data Collection and Governance in the Social Sector
Measuring Programmatic Impact and M&E Frameworks
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of non-profit operations, fundraising, or program management. Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel (e.g., filtering, basic formulas) is required. No prior coding or advanced statistical software experience is necessary. Participants must bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed; access to a free trial of Power BI or Tableau will be utilized during the course.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
